item.name: Request an error report for a PIM import job

request.name: Request an error report for a PIM import job

description.content:
Triggers the asynchronous generation of an XLSX error report listing the failed items of a given PIM
import job. Failed cells are highlighted and carry the validation message as a cell comment. Items whose
failure is technical (PIM-side operational error) are included in the file but not highlighted, so the
brand can simply re-upload them.

The operation is idempotent per PIM import job: a second call for the same `pim_import_job_id` returns
the existing report instead of creating a new one.

response.name: Unprocessable Entity : Data provided are invalid

description.content: Returns the error reports owned by the authenticated brand, sorted by descending creation date.

response.name: List of error reports for the authenticated brand, sorted by descending creation date.

description.content: Fetches a single error report. Use to poll its status until `completed` (or `failed`).

Streams the generated XLSX file for a completed error report. The endpoint returns 404 if the report is
not yet completed or if it has expired (reports are retained for 30 days after completion).

response.name: XLSX file containing the failed rows of the PIM import, with each cell that needs to be corrected highlighted in red and carrying a comment with the validation message.
